seo.title: Beard Trim & Razor Shave in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Beard trims, straight razor shaves and hot towel head and beard shaves in Carlsbad, NM, by Tim at Divinely Faded. Book your time on Booksy.
secondary: haircut and beard trim near me

paragraphs: Hot towels. A straight razor. A clean line.
There are three dedicated ways to book beard work with me, depending on whether you want the beard shaped with a haircut, shaved off on its own, or shaved together with your head.

alt.tim-beard-detailing: Tim detailing a reclined client's full beard with a towel
alt.shave-head-beard-trim: Smooth shaved head with a full salt-and-pepper beard

blocks.heading: Trim, shave or both.
blocks.lead: Every one of them uses hot towels.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: A haircut with your beard handled in the same visit: a trim or a line-up, a hot towel finish and straight razor detailing around the edges.

items.title: Straight Razor Beard Shave
items.body: A traditional wet shave. Hot towels first, then premium shaving cream, the razor, and a soothing aftershave to close it out.

items.title: Head & Beard Shave
items.body: A precision shave on the head and the beard together, with hot towels and a soothing aftershave balm at the end. The longest of the three.

blocks.heading: Why the towel.
paragraphs: A hot towel wrapped around the face softens the beard and relaxes the skin before a razor touches it. You lean back, the towel goes on, and for a minute nothing is asked of you.
Then the razor goes to work.

alt.hot-towel: Hot towel wrapped around a reclined client's face before a shave

blocks.heading: The full beard treatment.
paragraphs: The Luxury Grooming Experience includes a beard sculpt along with the haircut, a wash, facial steam, dual hot towels and razor detailing. If your beard is a big part of your look, that's the booking that gives it the most time.

items.q: Can I get a beard trim without a haircut?
items.a: On Booksy, a beard trim or line-up is part of the Signature Cut, and the Straight Razor Beard Shave is its own service. For anything else, text me and ask.
No. Beard dyeing isn't something I offer.
